parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to unbind all tags from the instance. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified in the request. Valid values:

- true
- false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:
- `instance`: reserved mode instance.
- `ALIYUN::GPDB::INSTANCE`: elastic mode instance.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
